title: Joining the Missourians: Scotty's gun arrest and the corporation band
summary: Opening Part 3, Thomas retells how Scotty's jail term opened a spot, how the corporation band worked, and how Lamar Wright knew him from Topeka.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: This is February the 13th, 1981. I'm sitting here talking to Walter Thomas, my dear friend, and we are both alumni of Cab Calloway's band, and we're just talking about some Jazz history on the Missourians. Let's talk about the Missourians today. How did you join the band?

Well, it so happened that I had played with a couple of guys in New York. And one of the guys got arrested for having a gun. You know, that was the time when the Sullivan Laws first got started. If they caught you with a gun, you just automatically got six months. So this guy had six months. And the thing was, I was supposed to come with the band...
Who was the cat that left?
Scotty. I just remember... You know, maybe his name was Scott. I only know him by his nickname. You know how so many musicians are just known by their nicknames.
Now, we're talking about the Missourians. This is a band that came out of...
Out of Missouri.
Out of Kansas City, Missouri.
Yeah, Kansas City and St. Louis.
And it was a corporation band, wasn't it?
Yeah, right.
Thomas (3) - 2
What does it mean by corporation band?
Well, they were all involved in the business and everything. They voted on things. They had one guy that was kind of the spokesman.
Officers, President and Secretary.
Yeah.
And they just put the money down, huh?
Yeah, right. And one of the guys in the band knew me; I always felt that he was the one that suggested to hire me...
Who was that?
Lammar Wright.
What did he play?
He played trumpet. Of course, I went to school in Topeka. That's how I happened to meet him.
Oh, you knew him in school in Topeka?
Yeah, I knew him. Because he was from Kansas City...
Oh, Lammar was from Kansas City.

Yeah, he was from Kansas City, and I knew him well. He used to date a girl, one of my classmates.
